scope: Local on-demand component backup/export implementation; production unchanged

implementation.independent_schedules: Advanced settings; existing enabled plans remain discoverable and unchanged
implementation.database_download: GET /admin/ops/backup/jobs/:job_id/download; Root user only; same verified file descriptor and retention lock

default_retention.cleanup: on success or explicit file maintenance

implementation.report_migration: Existing RestoreDrillRecord model changes report_uri from varchar(512) to text; centralized AutoMigrate registration retained

assertions: Zero policies can produce a real PostgreSQL custom dump
Existing varchar(512) report column migrates to text
Plugin business data survives isolated restore
Protection, actual file cleanup, mutual exclusion and restart scheduling remain valid

activation: Run normal make db-migrate, restart the user-managed Core with current code and refresh the UI
limits: No production deployment or service restart
Existing user Core/Web not restarted; new endpoints require current Core
Browser APIs are controlled fixtures, not live deployment acceptance
One-time media exports support registered local-media sources only
Linux and production scheduled complete-package acceptance remain separate
